audit.framing_9x16: Full vertical crop of WWE broadcast footage, centering dynamic action, wrestlers, and iShowSpeed across various years (2024, 2025, 2026).
audit.subtitle_craft: Bold white or colored typography with black outlines and shadows, centered on screen, emphasizing punchy catchphrases, sound effects like *BARK*, *WAIT FOR IT*, and announcer callouts.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Dynamic punch-ins and fast-paced camera tracking on iShowSpeed's reactions, takedowns, and mid-air diving moves to maximize impact.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: High-energy hype background music combined with heavy impact thuds, wrestling bell hits, and dramatic sound effects synced perfectly with takedowns and comedic moments.
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: Rapid cuts between iShowSpeed getting destroyed in earlier years and his triumphant comebacks and high-flying moves in later years, building a satisfying narrative arc.
standout_techniques: Dynamic speed ramping during high-flying wrestling moves
Instant replay framing for comedic takedown emphasis
On-screen text pop-ups synchronized with dramatic audio cues
Thematic progression across years (2024 to 2026) for narrative payoff
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Over-saturation of screen text obscuring key action shots
Excessive flashing color filters during action transitions
